on_screen_text.text: Harrison Ford's endorsement of Kamala hits hard ⬇️⬇️⬇️
“Kamala Harris will protect your right to disagree with her about policies or ideas”
PAID FOR BY HARRIS FOR PRESIDENT

spoken_summary: Actor Harrison Ford states that he is speaking out because dozens of former members of the Trump administration—'governors, generals'—are 'sounding alarms' and warning America 'don't do this again.' He notes that for many of these lifelong Republicans, this will be the first time they vote for a Democrat. Ford contrasts the two candidates, claiming 'Kamala Harris will protect your right to disagree with her about policies or ideas,' allowing for debate and progress. He says 'the other guy' (Trump) 'demands unquestioning loyalty' and 'wants revenge.' Ford concludes by identifying himself and stating he will use his vote to 'move forward' by voting for Kamala Harris.
audio_music: The video consists solely of spoken dialogue with no background music or sound effects. The tone is serious and somber.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced, static talking-head shot with occasional simple cuts between a frontal view and a three-quarter profile view of the speaker.
central_claim: Kamala Harris will protect democratic norms like the right to dissent, while Donald Trump is a threat to them, a fact confirmed by high-ranking officials from his own administration who now oppose him.
intended_effect: To persuade voters, especially moderate Republicans or independents, that Donald Trump is too dangerous to be president and that Kamala Harris is the responsible choice for safeguarding democracy.
